command:
set -eu
pid=$(systemctl show xochitl -p MainPID --value)
printf 'PID %s\n' "$pid"
cat "/proc/$pid/maps" | grep '/home/root/xovi/'
for p in /proc/$pid/fd/*; do target=$(readlink "$p" || true); case "$target" in socket:*) printf '%s %s\n' "$p" "$target";; esac; done
sha256sum /usr/lib/systemd/system/xochitl.service /etc/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d/00-xovi.conf /etc/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d/50-computed-widgets-01-preflight.conf /etc/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d/qt-resource-rebuilder.conf /usr/lib/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d/xochitl-service-override.conf
